7219.title: Legacy update responses crash Settings
7219.rootCauseOneLine: The Settings update row treats an absent scheduled field as present, then dereferences requiredIdleMs on undefined.
7219.proposedFix: Treat null and undefined scheduling metadata as no scheduled update; retain a regression against legacy SDK response fields.
7219.caveats: Exact exception repeated on trusted main in two checkouts. Native desktop/mobile and every-thread impact were not verified. The complete regression is inline in the HTML under the reports repository artifact policy.
